The `CLEARTEXT communication to 10.0.2.2 not permitted by network security policy` error occurs because Android (API 28+) disables cleartext HTTP traffic by default. Since the app stores user session tokens and handles personal borrowing history, cleartext traffic should not be enabled globally across the entire app. Instead, Android's Network Security Configuration allows permitting cleartext HTTP specifically for the local dev server (`10.0.2.2`) used in the debug build while keeping production traffic secured over TLS.

The following changes have been made:

1. Created [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-B-r2/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml) to explicitly permit cleartext traffic to `10.0.2.2`:
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<network-security-config>
    <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true">
        <domain includeSubdomains="true">10.0.2.2</domain>
    </domain-config>
</network-security-config>
```

2. Updated [<application> in AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-B-r2/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L10) to link the network security configuration:
```xml
    <application
        android:label="ShelfTap Lab"
        android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"
        android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar">
```
